failures.name: CavesOfOoo.Tests.RegionalSituationOptInTests.KnownLostRecoveryCanBeReadButCannotBeAcceptedOrRecreated(True)
failures.message:
Do not advertise an action absent from this known-lost offer.
  Expected: not String containing "choose accept"
  But was:  "the stranded lamp-oil consignment [not accepted]. source (16,6); return to merchant in sumphold (15,6). recover the marked sealed consignment containing 2 x ward oil intact; ordinary loose goods do not replace it. the marked consignment is unavailable. it cannot be accepted unless the original cargo becomes available again. follow the dry approach; heat makes peat release marsh gas. leaving the marked bank intact earns three extra drams. payment: 12 drams and one silver sand. reading does not accept this work. choose accept this request through the recipient's [c] actions if you wish to undertake it."
